description: The plot illustrates how Accuracy@1 (in percent) varies with the number of child nodes (tree width) for two models. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” on a linear scale, with values shown at 1, 3, 5, and 7 (tick interval 2). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 15 to 38 with labeled ticks at 15, 20, 25, 30, and 35 (tick interval 5). One line corresponds to GPT-4o, drawn in blue with circular markers and a solid line; it starts at 24.4 at x=1, rises to 28.9 at x=3, increases further to about 34.4 at x=5, then declines to 31.1 at x=7. The other line corresponds to Claude-3.5-Sonnet, drawn in a lighter blue with “x” markers and a solid line; it starts at 26.7 at x=1, increases to 27.8 at x=3, then decreases to 24.4 at x=5 and continues downward to 20.0 at x=7.
